question: In 2022 scientists from which campus of the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) have successfully extracted more than 95 percent of the uranium from natural seawater during an experiment?
solution:
The correct option is **Pune__.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Over 95% of the **uranium **in natural seawater was successfully removed during an experiment by a team of scientists from Pune's **Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER)**.
 
• Due to the growing threat posed by the expanding use of fossil fuels, it is critically necessary to identify sustainable and environmentally friendly energy sources on a worldwide scale.
 
• While growing in popularity, renewable energy sources like the sun and wind might not be sufficient to meet the world's escalating energy needs. Scientists from** Pune's Indian Institute of Science Education and Research** have retrieved over **95% of the uranium** present in **natural saltwater (IISER).**
 
• Natural uranium reserves are anticipated to exhaust over the next century, pushing nations to develop new methods of producing the vital component that powers nuclear power plants all over the world.
